user.title: Set up Luna
user.description: Choose the dashboard variant. After installation, use Configure to connect this home's sensors and devices.

init.title: Connect Luna sources
init.description: Select the entities Luna may observe. Linked devices are only stored; physical control remains disabled until you enable it separately.

data_description.presence_entity: A person, tracker, presence sensor, or input boolean.
data_description.energy_entity: A total energy sensor, for example in kWh.
data_description.power_entity: A current power sensor, for example in W.
data_description.calendar_entity: A Home Assistant calendar Luna may observe.
data_description.observation_entities: Additional sensors whose changes may be recorded on Luna's local timeline.
data_description.control_entities: Devices that may be used later. Selecting them does not enable control.

finish_configuration.title: Finish the Luna configuration
finish_configuration.description: Register the Luna packages and dashboard as described in INSTALLATIE.md. Selected dashboard file: `{dashboard_file}`.{dependency_note} Then validate the configuration and restart Home Assistant.
